title: Make Cognitive Diagnosis Model Enhanced by Graph KT
note: Full-text verified from the correct PDF: GKT-CD: Make Cognitive Diagnosis Model Enhanced by Graph-based Knowledge Tracing, DOI 10.1109/IJCNN52387.2021.9533298. The paper contains a genuine graph-based KT module: a temporal/session interaction graph is processed with a Gated-GNN/graph attention mechanism to trace the learning process and derive student latent/mastery representations. However, the paper explicitly defines the target problem as cognitive diagnosis: mining proficiency on knowledge concepts and predicting student performance, with the KT module feeding exercise and interaction/2D-IRT components. Therefore PRIMARY_ADJACENT_METHOD is retained rather than PRIMARY_CORE. No exclusion code applies.
